events.title: Stories of Our Land (AUS)
events.description: Stories of Our Land is a powerful contemporary First Nations performance bringing together young artists from across Australia to share their own stories of Country, identity, ancestry and lived experience.Through powerful emotive vocals, original music, dance, live strings and cinematic imagery filmed on Country, these deeply personal stories are woven into an unforgettable journey that invites audiences to listen, reflect and connect with the world’s oldest living culture.

events.title: Robert Forster & His Swedish Band (AUS)
events.description: When Robert Forster’s ninth solo album, Strawberries, was released in May 2025, Robert was adamant that when he toured the album in Australia, it had to be with the Swedes that played on the record. Knowing their brilliance in the studio and on stage from previous European tours, he was determined to bring this particular show to Australia. To showcase the power and beauty the band brings to the Strawberries songs – the album listed at #7 in MOJO’s Top 75 Albums of 2025 – the setlist...

events.title: Kita Alexander (AUS)
events.description: Kita Alexander is set to celebrate the release of her sophomore album, ‘RAGE’ (out June 26), with an Australian headline tour.
